description: Check that a payment pays the beneficiary institution through the correspondent and account in the user's own SSI file. Reads the route from a pacs.008 (creditor agent, last intermediary, CdtrAgtAcct) or pacs.009 (creditor, creditor agent, CdtrAcct), or from explicit fields, then looks up owner BIC + currency + asset category and compares with the preferred SSI effective on the value date. Returns MATCH, ACCOUNT_MISMATCH, AGENT_MISMATCH, NOT_PREFERRED, AMBIGUOUS_SSI, NO_EFFECTIVE_SSI or NO_SSI per transaction. Accounts are masked.

account.description: Account at the correspondent used by the payment. Overrides the message.

account_holder_bic.description: Correspondent (account-holding institution) BIC used by the payment. Overrides the message.

asset_category.description: SSI asset category such as COPA, CASH, FOEX, SECU. Overrides the default for the message type.

column_map.description: For an export whose headers are not recognised (any provider, for example LexisNexis or an in-house system): map SSI fields to header names, for example {"ownerBic": "Bank SWIFT", "accountHolderBic": "Nostro Agent", "currency": "Ccy"}. Fields: recordKey, ownerBic, ownerName, ownerCountry, ownerId, market, currency, assetCategory, accountHolderBic, accountHolderName, accountHolderCountry, account, preferredFlag, holderType, startDate, stopDate, status, lastConfirmed.

owner_bic.description: Beneficiary institution BIC (the SSI owner). Overrides the message.

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

ssi_content.description: The SSI file content, inline (small files only).

ssi_path.description: Path to the user's SSI file: SWIFTRef SSI Plus V3, a SWIFTRef Payments Directory RELATIONSHIPS file, or a CSV/TSV from any provider.

value_date.description: Value date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the message settlement date, else today.

name: check_payment_against_ssi
title: Check payment against SSI file
